ekadashi.name: Ekadashi Vrat
ekadashi.criteria: 11th lunar day of Shukla or Krishna Paksha of every Hindu month
ekadashi.since_when: Since the Satya Yuga, instituted by Lord Vishnu to destroy worldly sins.
ekadashi.why_reason: On this day, the demon Mura was slain by the female energy (Ekadashi) born from Lord Vishnu's body.
ekadashi.belief: Observance washes away past life sins, purifies the mind, and guarantees ascent to Vaikuntha (Vishnu's abode).
ekadashi.where: Observed globally by Vaishnavas and Hindus.
ekadashi.how: Complete fast (upavasa) or fruit-only diet, avoiding grains, rice, and beans. Perform Vishnu Puja and stay awake chanting mantras.

trayodashi.name: Pradosh Vrat
trayodashi.criteria: 13th lunar day of Shukla or Krishna Paksha of every Hindu month
trayodashi.since_when: Since Vedic times, when the Devas and Asuras churned the ocean.
trayodashi.why_reason: Lord Shiva consumed the Halahala poison on this day to save the universe and danced in bliss during twilight.
trayodashi.belief: Observance removes all obstacles, bestows wealth, health, and releases one from ancestral karma.
trayodashi.how: Fast from sunrise until sunset. Perform Shiva Abhishek with milk, honey, and water during Pradosha Kalam (twilight hours).

sankranti.name: Sankranti
sankranti.criteria: Transit of Sun from one zodiac sign to another
sankranti.since_when: Since astronomical records of ancient Rishis (approx. 5000+ years).
sankranti.why_reason: Solar transit marks the shift in seasonal energies and solar rays affecting human consciousness.
sankranti.belief: Holy bathing, charity, and solar worship on Sankranti fetch infinite blessings and longevity.
sankranti.where: Observed all over India with regional names (Makar Sankranti, Bihu, Pongal, Vishu).
sankranti.how: Take a dip in sacred rivers at sunrise. Offer Arghya (water) to the Sun God, distribute sesame seeds, jaggery, and donate food to the needy.

rath_yatra.name: Jagannath Rath Yatra
rath_yatra.since_when: Since the regime of King Indradyumna in Satya Yuga (Puranic records).
rath_yatra.why_reason: Annual visit of Lord Jagannath, along with siblings Balabhadra and Subhadra, to their maternal aunt's temple (Gundicha Temple).
rath_yatra.belief: Touching or pulling the chariot of Lord Jagannath cleanses all sins and frees the soul from rebirth.
rath_yatra.where: Puri, Odisha, India (and replicated in global cities).
rath_yatra.how: Pulling the giant wooden chariots, singing kirtans, and distributing Mahaprasad.

kumbh_mela.name: Kumbh Mela
kumbh_mela.criteria: Specific Jupiter and Sun placements in Aries, Taurus, Leo, and Aquarius
kumbh_mela.since_when: Since the Samudra Churning (Samudra Manthan) era.
kumbh_mela.why_reason: Drops of Amrit (nectar of immortality) fell from the pitcher (Kumbh) at Haridwar, Prayagraj, Nashik, and Ujjain during a chase between Devas and Asuras.
kumbh_mela.belief: Holy bath in the sacred rivers during Kumbh resolves all karmic bonds and grants instant Moksha.
kumbh_mela.where: Haridwar, Prayagraj, Nashik, and Ujjain on a 12-year cyclic rotation.
kumbh_mela.how: Taking holy baths in the river (Shahi Snan) at calculated astronomical muhurtas, attending religious discourses, and serving sadhus.
